tool: Siril 1.4.4 — un-registered lights: CFA convert -> calibrate -dark -> stack (-norm=mul); Siril stat regional crops + findstar + autostretch preview

build.desky: Siril seqsubsky 2 on the dark-subtracted source frames before stacking — removes the additive sky plane that is fixed in the sensor frame on a fixed mount (moonlight / airmass) and does NOT reject out of the flat
build.frame_source: ALL raw frames in the set dir

gate: smooth falloff (corners < centre), NO structured sky residual (the Milky Way star field) on the preview, speck count ~0; the eye check + the with/without finals comparison gate adoption (dead-end registry: a sky flat preserves frame-filling faint structure only when validated — that structure is UNRESOLVED STARLIGHT, not dust)
